Trimer backbone detail: one open linear chain, not a triangle (schematic):
Arᵢ = p-C₆H₄–CH₂–NDI. Three pendant groups; six backbone carbons, five C–C bonds, two ends.
Separate-segment model: two intact monomer segments, in parallel and antiparallel starting poses.
Purple: open polymer backbone. H caps are implicit. Current pilot uses 1–3 repeats; no whole-bead models.
